title: MacBook Air Repair
subtitle: It sat in our attic for years waiting for me to acquire the hardware repair skills necessary to tackle it
description: My wife vaguely remembers a water bottle leaking in her bag, which also contained her MacBook.

WhatsApp Image 2026-09-30 at 22.07.13.jp: My Yojock meter shows voltage but zero amps being drawn, so this MacBook is definitely not going to turn on. I get the exact same result from the other USB-C port.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-30 at 22.42.35.jp: My first impression looking under the hood? Wow, this is a gorgeous piece of hardware.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-30 at 22.42.44.jp: I'm totally new to this, but I'm guessing that tarnish on the little metal shield could be explained by liquid.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-30 at 22.42.44 (1: Okay... given that the connector is completely destroyed, I'm now certain I'm not the first amateur to open this up and take a look.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-30 at 22.42.45.jp: I took the audio jack board out to inspect it under my microscope. The good news is there’s no obvious liquid damage underneath it.
IMG_003.JPG: Again, I'm new to this, but this definitely looks like liquid damage to me.
IMG_004.JPG: This connector is absolute toast! What the hell even happened here?
IMG_001.JPG: Now I've got the model number 820-01929-A. Maybe just replacing this board will be enough to bring the MacBook back to life!
Screenshot 2026-09-30 at 23.25.45.png: I can have it by Friday? Yes please!
WhatsApp Image 2026-10-01 at 09.29.47.jp: I pulled the logic board out to swap out the old audio jack flex cable. Thankfully, there's no liquid damage underneath it.
WhatsApp Image 2026-10-01 at 09.29.47 (1: Removed the old chewed up audio jack flex cable
WhatsApp Image 2026-10-02 at 16.52.50.jp: The new cable and audio jack board arrived!
WhatsApp Image 2026-10-02 at 16.52.57.jp: After installing the new audio jack board, I'm seeing a current draw, but the laptop still won't turn on. I'm going to let it charge for 30 minutes since the battery is completely dead from sitting in the attic for a few years.
WhatsApp Image 2026-10-02 at 16.52.43.jp: Thirty minutes later, it powers on and the Apple logo appears. What a beautiful sight!
Next up, I need to clean this filthy screen.
